Accepted: 'Mission mission' is declared at input.c:272 under '#ifdef PLATFORM_PS4' (:266) and at :282 under '#ifdef PLATFORM_XBOX' (:278), in two consecutive blocks; the detector treats only the arms of one #ifdef/#else as exclusive. Neither block compiles in a PC build.

Accepted: the '#ifdef ENABLE_LOGGING' block at bunkerbroadcasthandler.c:338-340, inside a method, holds only a comment. DayZDiag defines ENABLE_LOGGING on server and client: the script logs of the dayz-mcp v1.4 release game (DayZDiag 1.30.164078, 2026-10-17) list it, with DIAG_DEVELOPER, among the defines of every script module on both, so World compiled this block with the macro set, and both processes ended normally. The rule stays live for mods until the segfault that pitfalls-advanced.md:66 describes is measured again (pipeline inbox dada).

Accepted: the '#ifdef DIAG_DEVELOPER' block at environment.c:1-3 holds only a comment. DayZDiag defines DIAG_DEVELOPER on server and client (the dayz-mcp v1.4 release game, DayZDiag 1.30.164078, 2026-10-17, logged its DIAG_DEVELOPER-only plugin on both), and that game ran this file without a crash, so the segfault that pitfalls-advanced.md:66 describes did not happen here. The rule stays live for mods until that claim is measured again (pipeline inbox dada).

tree.dayz_build_note: Build of the measured tree: DayZ 1.30.164200 stable (DayZDiag_x64.exe file version 1.30.164.200, product version 1.30.164200.56), tree digest d24552ffc661b3ee2e6791013bf8cd8e3ef5dbbcde08f0e7a6a9a84f8efd0b23. sources/source-map.json declares the build the pack is anchored on, which can be older. Identity of the control tree is the digest; set this deliberately when re-baselining after a patch.
tree.digest_scope: sha256 over (posix relpath, sha256 of contents) of every file the validator discovers under the vanilla root, in walk order. Not comparable to the vanilla_index digest, which covers .c only.

what_this_is: Expected findings of dayz-script-validator over Bohemia's vanilla script tree. The tree compiles and ships, so any finding on it is a false positive by construction: this file is the allowlist of the ones already triaged, each with the reason it is tolerated. A finding that is NOT here fails the control.
